entries.q: How long does it take to charge the battery?
entries.a: With the standard 4 A charger: about 3.5 hours for the Pup, 4 to 4.5 hours for the Mule and the Trike, 5 hours for the Barge 2's 750 Wh battery. The Range Extender charges separately in about 3 hours.

Frames are guaranteed for 10 years. Motors, batteries and electronics for 2 years, or 800 full charge cycles for batteries, whichever comes first. Wear parts (tyres, brake pads, chains and belts) are not covered.

entries.q: How much weight can the Trike carry?
entries.a: The Trike is approved for a total of 250 kg, rider and cargo included.

entries.q: Can I fit the Range Extender to my bike?
entries.a: The Range Extender works with the Barge 2 only. It is not compatible with the Mule, the Pup, the Trike or the first-generation Barge.
It is engraved under the bottom bracket and starts with ARV25- for bikes built in 2025. It is also on your invoice.

entries.q: When is the first service due?
entries.a: After 300 km or 3 months, whichever comes first, then every 2,000 km or once a year.

entries.q: How many children can I carry?
entries.a: Barge 2: up to 3 children in the box with the bench and harnesses. Mule: 2 children on the rear rack with approved seats. Pup: 1 child seat. Trike: 2 children with the bench kit.

entries.q: Is there a recall on my battery?
entries.a: There is no recall. A free voluntary inspection campaign is running for some bikes built in July and August 2025. Your dealer can check your serial number in a few seconds.

entries.q: Do you deliver to Spain or Italy?
entries.a: Not yet. We currently sell in France, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Switzerland, Austria and the United Kingdom.

entries.q: Can I return a bike bought online?
entries.a: Yes, within 14 days of delivery, in its original condition. We refund the full price including delivery.

entries.q: Which tyre pressure should I use?
entries.a: Front-loaders: 2.5 to 3.0 bar front, 3.0 to 3.5 bar rear when loaded. Follow the range printed on the tyre sidewall.
